author: NASA
text:
We had a great time at MAX POWER — and made a lot of news!

We're recruiting a new class of astronauts, making major advancements on the Moon Base, and challenging students to a $1 million design competition. Catch up with everything we announced at the festival: https://www.nasa.gov/general/max-power-nasas-inaugural-aerospace-expo-ignites-americas-future/
